== Template:Item/Armor ==

Master template for displaying complete armor tooltips. Combines header, stats, vitals, resists, class restrictions, and optional proc effects.

=== Parameters ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Required !! Description
|-
| '''icon''' || Yes || Full item icon file title, including its extension
|-
| '''name''' || Yes || Armor name
|-
| '''value''' || No || Item value in gold, or "Unsellable"
|-
| '''slot''' || Yes || Armor slot: Head, Neck, Ring, Hand, Chest, Arm, Bracer, Leg, Waist, Foot, Back
|-
| '''tier''' || No || Quality tier: 0=Normal (default), 1=Blessed, 2=Godly
|-
| '''relic''' || No || Set to any value for relic items
|-
| '''str, end, dex, agi, int, wis, cha''' || No || Stat modifiers (default: 0)
|-
| '''res''' || No || Resonance modifier (default: 0)
|-
| '''health, mana, armor''' || No || Vital modifiers (default: 0)
|-
| '''magic, poison, elemental, void''' || No || Resist modifiers (default: 0)
|-
| '''description''' || No || Flavor text
|-
| '''arcanist, duelist, druid, paladin, reaver, stormcaller''' || No || Class restrictions (set to any value)
|-
| '''proc_style''' || No || Worn, Activatable, or Cast (for bracers)
|-
| '''must_equip''' || No || Show "Must Equip to Cast" under an activatable effect
|-
| '''proc_chance''' || No || Proc chance percentage (for Cast style bracers)
|-
| '''proc_spell_name''' || No || If set, displays spell effect details
|-
| '''proc_*''' || No || Various proc parameters (see Item/SpellDetails)
|}

=== Examples ===

==== Basic Armor (No Proc) ====

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/Armor
|icon=Cloth Hood icon.png
|name=Cloth Hood
|slot=Head
|tier=0
|armor=2
|description=A Cloth Hood
|arcanist=1
|duelist=1
|druid=1
|paladin=1
|stormcaller=1
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item/Armor
|icon=Cloth Hood icon.png
|name=Cloth Hood
|slot=Head
|tier=0
|armor=2
|description=A Cloth Hood
|arcanist=1
|duelist=1
|druid=1
|paladin=1
|stormcaller=1
}}
